mapper.sql: a.id AS attempt_id, JSON_OBJECT('sourceSystem',a.source_system,'requestId',a.request_id,'traceId',a.trace_id,'scopeType',a.scope_type, 'tenantId',a.actor_tenant_id,'actorId',a.actor_id,'storeId',a.store_id,'action',a.action_code,'resourceId',a.resource_id, 'occurredAt',DATE_FORMAT(a.occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'policy',a.policy_code, 'policyVersion',a.policy_version,'schemaVersion',a.schema_version) AS attempt, IF(p.id IS NULL,NULL,JSON_OBJECT('id',p.id,'action',p.audit_action_code,'resourceId',p.audit_resource_id, 'beforeVersion',p.audit_before_version,'afterVersion',p.audit_after_version,'reason',p.audit_reason, 'changes',p.audit_changes_json,'recordedAt',DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'))) AS effect, (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',o.id,'eventRef',o.event_ref,'result',o.result_code,'errorCode',o.error_code,'effectId',o.effect_id, 'recordedAt',DATE_FORMAT(o.recorded_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) FROM audit_attempt_outcome o WHERE o.attempt_id=a.id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS outcome
mapper.select: SELECT FROM audit_operation_attempt a FORCE INDEX (ix_audit_archive_candidate) LEFT JOIN platform_audit p ON p.audit_attempt_id=a.id LEFT JOIN audit_archive_member m ON m.attempt_id=a.id WHERE a.scope_type=#{scope.type} AND a.actor_tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} AND a.occurred_at < #{olderThan} AND (p.id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_attempt_outcome o WHERE o.attempt_id=a.id)) AND m.attempt_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.occurred_at,a.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM audit_archive_batch WHERE scope_type=#{scope.type} AND tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} AND state IN ('CLAIMED','UPLOADED') ORDER BY created_at,batch_id LIMIT 1

SELECT policy_code,policy_version,online_days,total_days,approval_reference FROM audit_archive_retention_policy WHERE scope_type=#{scope.type} AND tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND approved_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY policy_code,policy_version

SELECT FROM audit_archive_member m JOIN audit_archive_batch b ON b.batch_id=m.batch_id JOIN audit_operation_attempt a ON a.id=m.attempt_id AND a.scope_type=b.scope_type AND a.actor_tenant_id=b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN platform_audit p ON p.audit_attempt_id=a.id WHERE m.batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY a.occurred_at,a.id
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_archive_batch SET state='UPLOADED',object_version=#{version},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state='CLAIMED'
UPDATE audit_archive_batch SET state='VERIFIED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND object_version=#{version} AND state='UPLOADED'
mapper.select: SELECT g.ticket_id,g.batch_id,g.requested_by,g.approved_by,g.expires_at FROM audit_archive_restore_grant g JOIN audit_archive_batch b ON b.batch_id=g.batch_id WHERE g.ticket_id=#{ticket} AND g.requested_by=#{actorId} AND b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.scope_type=#{scopeType} AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.state IN ('VERIFIED','ONLINE_PURGED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO audit_archive_restored(ticket_id,batch_id,attempt_id,payload,expires_at) VALUES
(#{grant.ticketId},#{grant.batchId},#{row.attemptId},#{row.payload},#{grant.expiresAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expires_at=audit_archive_restored.expires_at
